steps.en: Install the app (menu bar + CLI in one binary)
steps.zh: 装上应用（菜单栏和 CLI 同一个二进制）

steps.en: Add a vendor as a provider: a preset needs only its key
steps.zh: 把一家厂商加成 provider：预设只要填 key

steps.en: Asks the vendor which models it serves and adds them to one provider/model catalog
steps.zh: 向厂商拉真实模型列表，并进统一的 provider/model 目录

steps.en: Point an agent at any catalog model
steps.zh: 给某个 agent 选一个目录里的模型

steps.en: Rewrites only that key in the agent's own config file, aiming it at the local gateway
steps.zh: 只改该 agent 配置文件里那一个键，把它指向本地网关

steps.en: Translates each request between Anthropic and OpenAI APIs and forwards it to the vendor
steps.zh: 每个请求在 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 协议间翻译后转给厂商

value.en: Any agent runs on any vendor's model without you hand-editing five config formats or running a translation proxy per agent
value.zh: 任何 agent 都能跑任何厂商的模型，不用手改五种格式的配置文件，也不用给每个 agent 各配一个协议转换代理

sources: https://github.com/yetone/magpie#providers-and-the-gateway (magpie provider add deepseek sk-…, magpie claude deepseek/deepseek-chat, provider/model catalog, real model lists)
https://github.com/yetone/magpie#connecting-anything-else (gateway on 127.0.0.1:3425; translation between OpenAI chat/Responses and Anthropic Messages; Claude Code env block edits)
README bullet 'Edits config files surgically' (only the one key you change is touched)
